question_en: The market closes at 6 pm. Does bringing the tables inside at 5:45 pm fit the stated plan?

A.source: Stolove ćemo unijeti prije zatvaranja tržnice. Možeš li nam pomoći?
A.reference_en: We’ll bring the tables inside before the market closes. Can you help us?

B.source: Stolove ćemo unijeti poslije zatvaranja tržnice. Možeš li nam pomoći?
B.reference_en: We’ll bring the tables inside after the market closes. Can you help us?

question_en: The bakery normally opens at 8 am. Is it due to open at 9 am on Friday?

A.source: U petak pekarnicu otvaramo sat ranije nego inače.
A.reference_en: On Friday we’re opening the bakery an hour earlier than usual.

B.source: U petak pekarnicu otvaramo sat kasnije nego inače.
B.reference_en: On Friday we’re opening the bakery an hour later than usual.

question_en: Does packing seven jars in every box meet the instruction?

A.source: U svaku kutiju za štand stavi najviše šest staklenki meda.
A.reference_en: Put at most six jars of honey in each box for the stall.

B.source: U svaku kutiju za štand stavi najmanje šest staklenki meda.
B.reference_en: Put at least six jars of honey in each box for the stall.

question_en: There are eight of us. Does our team meet the stated condition for signing up?

A.source: Za čišćenje plaže prijavi našu ekipu samo ako nas ima više od deset.
A.reference_en: Sign our team up for the beach cleanup only if there are more than ten of us.

B.source: Za čišćenje plaže prijavi našu ekipu samo ako nas ima manje od deset.
B.reference_en: Sign our team up for the beach cleanup only if there are fewer than ten of us.

question_en: Practice is in a gym today. Does the venue meet the speaker’s condition for coming?

A.source: Na veslački trening dolazim samo ako se održava unutra.
A.reference_en: I’ll come to rowing practice only if it’s held indoors.

B.source: Na veslački trening dolazim samo ako se održava vani.
B.reference_en: I’ll come to rowing practice only if it’s held outdoors.

question_en: I plan to return the handcart clean but unfolded. Does that meet the lender’s stated condition?

A.source: Ručna kolica ti mogu posuditi samo ako ih vratiš čista.
A.reference_en: I can lend you the handcart only if you return it clean.

B.source: Ručna kolica ti mogu posuditi samo ako ih vratiš sklopljena.
B.reference_en: I can lend you the handcart only if you return it folded up.

question_en: Can I drop off used cooking oil on Friday under these opening arrangements?

A.source: Rabljeno jestivo ulje primamo svaki dan osim ponedjeljka.
A.reference_en: We accept used cooking oil every day except Monday.

B.source: Rabljeno jestivo ulje primamo svaki dan osim petka.
B.reference_en: We accept used cooking oil every day except Friday.

question_en: A glass bowl is on the table. Do these instructions allow it in the dishwasher?

A.source: U perilicu ide sve sa stola osim drvenih zdjela.
A.reference_en: Everything on the table goes in the dishwasher except the wooden bowls.

B.source: U perilicu ide sve sa stola osim staklenih zdjela.
B.reference_en: Everything on the table goes in the dishwasher except the glass bowls.

question_en: Under this rule, may I take a chair upstairs in the lift?

A.source: Da znaš, kod nas je zabranjeno unositi namještaj u dizalo.
A.reference_en: Just so you know, it’s forbidden to take furniture in the lift here.

B.source: Da znaš, kod nas je dopušteno unositi namještaj u dizalo.
B.reference_en: Just so you know, it’s permitted to take furniture in the lift here.

question_en: Does the stated apron rule allow me to take part without an apron?

A.source: Jutros su mi rekli da je pregača na lončarskoj radionici obvezna.
A.reference_en: They told me this morning that an apron is required at the pottery workshop.

B.source: Jutros su mi rekli da je pregača na lončarskoj radionici neobvezna.
B.reference_en: They told me this morning that an apron is optional at the pottery workshop.

question_en: The chair belongs only to the person marking the list. Should they mark it?

A.source: Na popisu za selidbu označi samo svoje stvari.
A.reference_en: On the moving checklist, mark only your own things.

B.source: Na popisu za selidbu označi samo moje stvari.
B.reference_en: On the moving checklist, mark only my things.

question_en: The quote has three pages. Should I print page three in colour?

A.source: Molim te, u boji ispiši samo prvu stranicu ponude.
A.reference_en: Please print only the first page of the quote in colour.

B.source: Molim te, u boji ispiši samo zadnju stranicu ponude.
B.reference_en: Please print only the last page of the quote in colour.

question_en: Is 5 pm within the time when I can practise here?

A.source: Na saksofonie mogę tu ćwiczyć tylko przed 18:00.
A.reference_en: I can only practise the saxophone here before 6 pm.

B.source: Na saksofonie mogę tu ćwiczyć tylko po 18:00.
B.reference_en: I can only practise the saxophone here after 6 pm.

question_en: Can I use the basement laundry room on the seventh of the month?

A.source: Z pralni w piwnicy mogę korzystać tylko w parzyste dni miesiąca.
A.reference_en: I can only use the basement laundry room on even-numbered days of the month.

B.source: Z pralni w piwnicy mogę korzystać tylko w nieparzyste dni miesiąca.
B.reference_en: I can only use the basement laundry room on odd-numbered days of the month.

question_en: Does a group of seven meet your group-size requirement?

A.source: Na warsztaty ceramiczne przyjmujemy tylko grupy liczące najwyżej sześć osób.
A.reference_en: For our pottery workshops, we only accept groups of at most six people.

B.source: Na warsztaty ceramiczne przyjmujemy tylko grupy liczące przynajmniej sześć osób.
B.reference_en: For our pottery workshops, we only accept groups of at least six people.

question_en: Does a four-centimetre screw meet the length rule for this compartment?

A.source: Do tej przegródki wkładaj tylko wkręty krótsze niż pięć centymetrów.
A.reference_en: Only put screws shorter than five centimetres in this compartment.

B.source: Do tej przegródki wkładaj tylko wkręty dłuższe niż pięć centymetrów.
B.reference_en: Only put screws longer than five centimetres in this compartment.

question_en: I have only an original paper invitation. Does it meet the entry condition?

A.source: Na pokaz przedpremierowy wpuszczamy tylko osoby z papierowym zaproszeniem.
A.reference_en: We only let people into the preview screening if they have a paper invitation.

B.source: Na pokaz przedpremierowy wpuszczamy tylko osoby z elektronicznym zaproszeniem.
B.reference_en: We only let people into the preview screening if they have an electronic invitation.

question_en: You and I have each counted every box separately. We never counted them together. Has the condition for signing been met?

A.source: Podpiszę spis dopiero wtedy, gdy ty i ja policzymy te kartony razem.
A.reference_en: I’ll only sign the inventory once you and I have counted these boxes together.

B.source: Podpiszę spis dopiero wtedy, gdy ty i ja policzymy te kartony osobno.
B.reference_en: I’ll only sign the inventory once you and I have each counted these boxes separately.

question_en: I run a stall at the fair and I’m not a volunteer. Do I have to pay for lemonade?

A.source: Na naszym kiermaszu wszyscy płacą za lemoniadę oprócz wolontariuszy.
A.reference_en: At our fair, everyone pays for lemonade except the volunteers.

B.source: Na naszym kiermaszu wszyscy płacą za lemoniadę oprócz wystawców.
B.reference_en: At our fair, everyone pays for lemonade except the stallholders.

question_en: Does the request include wiping down the upper cabinets?

A.source: Przetrzyj proszę wszystkie szafki w kuchni poza górnymi.
A.reference_en: Please wipe down all the kitchen cabinets except the upper ones.

B.source: Przetrzyj proszę wszystkie szafki w kuchni poza dolnymi.
B.reference_en: Please wipe down all the kitchen cabinets except the lower ones.

question_en: Under the stated team rule, may I choose to skip the Friday briefing?

A.source: W moim zespole udział w piątkowej odprawie jest obowiązkowy.
A.reference_en: In my team, attending the Friday briefing is compulsory.

B.source: W moim zespole udział w piątkowej odprawie jest dobrowolny.
B.reference_en: In my team, attending the Friday briefing is optional.

question_en: May I eat a sandwich in the board game room?

A.source: W naszej sali z planszówkami jedzenie jest dozwolone.
A.reference_en: Eating is allowed in our board game room.

B.source: W naszej sali z planszówkami jedzenie jest zabronione.
B.reference_en: Eating is forbidden in our board game room.

question_en: Does the request allow me to send the floor plan to the night crew?

A.source: Prześlij proszę plan piętra wyłącznie dziennej ekipie.
A.reference_en: Please send the floor plan only to the day crew.

B.source: Prześlij proszę plan piętra wyłącznie nocnej ekipie.
B.reference_en: Please send the floor plan only to the night crew.

question_en: Can I redeem this voucher when buying something online?

A.source: Tego bonu użyjesz tylko w sklepie internetowym.
A.reference_en: You can only use this voucher in the online shop.

B.source: Tego bonu użyjesz tylko w sklepie stacjonarnym.
B.reference_en: You can only use this voucher in the physical shop.

question_en: Would discussing the film half an hour before the screening fit the club’s timing rule?

A.source: В нашем киноклубе фильм обсуждают только до показа.
A.reference_en: At our film club, we only discuss the film before the screening.

B.source: В нашем киноклубе фильм обсуждают только после показа.
B.reference_en: At our film club, we only discuss the film after the screening.

question_en: Would an evening fitting at 7 pm work for the speaker?

A.source: Мне удобно примерить костюм только утром. После обеда у меня занятия.
A.reference_en: The morning is the only time that works for me to try on the costume. I have classes after lunch.

B.source: Мне удобно примерить костюм только вечером. После обеда у меня занятия.
B.reference_en: The evening is the only time that works for me to try on the costume. I have classes after lunch.

question_en: There are twelve chairs. Would leaving ten in the room and taking the other two into the hall meet the request?

A.source: Для гостей оставь в комнате больше восьми стульев, остальные вынеси в коридор.
A.reference_en: Leave more than eight chairs in the room for the guests and take the rest out into the hall.

B.source: Для гостей оставь в комнате меньше восьми стульев, остальные вынеси в коридор.
B.reference_en: Leave fewer than eight chairs in the room for the guests and take the rest out into the hall.

question_en: Would printing five photos satisfy this request?

A.source: Для витрины распечатай ровно четыре фотографии.
A.reference_en: Print exactly four photos for the window display.

B.source: Для витрины распечатай минимум четыре фотографии.
B.reference_en: Print at least four photos for the window display.

question_en: The application has been approved. Does that satisfy the condition for messaging the speaker?

A.source: Напиши мне про заявку на пропуск только после того, как её одобрят.
A.reference_en: Message me about the pass application only after it’s been approved.

B.source: Напиши мне про заявку на пропуск только после того, как её отклонят.
B.reference_en: Message me about the pass application only after it’s been rejected.

question_en: I send only a description. Have I sent what was requested for the catalogue?

A.source: Чтобы я включила работу в каталог, пришли название и описание.
A.reference_en: For me to include the piece in the catalogue, send me the title and a description.

B.source: Чтобы я включила работу в каталог, пришли название или описание.
B.reference_en: For me to include the piece in the catalogue, send me the title or a description.

question_en: There is a freestanding floor lamp. Are we taking it with us?

A.source: Из старой квартиры забираем все светильники, кроме настенных.
A.reference_en: We’re taking all the lamps from the old flat except the wall lamps.

B.source: Из старой квартиры забираем все светильники, кроме напольных.
B.reference_en: We’re taking all the lamps from the old flat except the floor lamps.

question_en: Should notifications for incoming messages stay on?

A.source: На рабочем телефоне отключи все уведомления, кроме уведомлений о звонках.
A.reference_en: On the work phone, turn off all notifications except those for calls.

B.source: На рабочем телефоне отключи все уведомления, кроме уведомлений о сообщениях.
B.reference_en: On the work phone, turn off all notifications except those for messages.

question_en: May a visiting guest print a page there?

A.source: У нас в коворкинге гостям можно пользоваться принтером.
A.reference_en: At our coworking space, guests are allowed to use the printer.

B.source: У нас в коворкинге гостям нельзя пользоваться принтером.
B.reference_en: At our coworking space, guests are not allowed to use the printer.

question_en: Under this chat rule, may I send a voice message instead of typing?

A.source: У нас в общем чате голосовые сообщения запрещены.
A.reference_en: Voice messages aren’t allowed in our group chat.

B.source: У нас в общем чате голосовые сообщения разрешены.
B.reference_en: Voice messages are allowed in our group chat.

question_en: Should I close the upstairs hall windows after rehearsal?

A.source: После репетиции закрой окна только в верхнем зале.
A.reference_en: After rehearsal, close the windows only in the upstairs hall.

B.source: После репетиции закрой окна только в нижнем зале.
B.reference_en: After rehearsal, close the windows only in the downstairs hall.

question_en: The building has four entrance halls. Would putting a notice in just one entrance hall fulfil the request?

A.source: Повесь памятку о сортировке мусора в каждом подъезде.
A.reference_en: Put up a recycling notice in each entrance hall.

B.source: Повесь памятку о сортировке мусора в одном подъезде.
B.reference_en: Put up a recycling notice in one entrance hall.
